01运行前的观察目标02同初值普通网络与残差网络：梯度、尺度和优化对照03代码说明

运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

输出 12 行对照数据；同一深度、同一 α\alphaα 的两个网络初值完全一致。所有训练结果有限，但不保证残差的 MSE 总小于普通网络；两个线性反例严格得到零梯度和 2122^{12}212 放大。

python 12_residual_demo.py环境配置

同初值普通网络与残差网络：梯度、尺度和优化对照

12_residual_demo.py
import copyimport mathimport torchfrom torch import nn torch.set_num_threads(1)torch.manual_seed(41)dtype = torch.float64width, batch = 12, 48x_train = 0.7 * torch.randn(batch, width, dtype=dtype)teacher = torch.linalg.qr(torch.randn(width, width, dtype=dtype)).Qy_train = torch.sin(x_train @ teacher)upstream = torch.randn(batch, width, dtype=dtype)upstream = upstream / upstream.norm() class Stack(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, depth, alpha, skip):        super().__init__()        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(nn.Linear(width, width) for _ in range(depth))        self.readout = nn.Linear(width, width)        self.alpha, self.skip = alpha, skip        self.to(dtype)        for index, layer in enumerate(self.layers):            generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1000 + index)            with torch.no_grad():                layer.weight.copy_(torch.randn(width, width, generator=generator, dtype=dtype) / math.sqrt(width))                layer.bias.zero_()        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2000)        with torch.no_grad():            self.readout.weight.copy_(torch.randn(width, width, generator=generator, dtype=dtype) / math.sqrt(width))            self.readout.bias.zero_()     def features(self, x):        for layer in self.layers:            update = self.alpha * torch.tanh(layer(x))            x = x + update if self.skip else update        return x     def forward(self, x):        return self.readout(self.features(x)) def probe(model):    x = x_train.detach().clone().requires_grad_()    parameters = (model.layers[0].weight, model.layers[-1].weight)    # 相同输出方向的 VJP，避免把不同初始预测误差混入 Jacobian 比较。    gradients = torch.autograd.grad((model(x) * upstream).sum(), (x, *parameters))    assert all(torch.isfinite(g).all() for g in gradients)    with torch.no_grad():        activation_rms = model.features(x_train).square().mean().sqrt().item()    return [g.norm().item() for g in gradients] + [activation_rms] def train(model, steps=100):    # 同一数据、优化器、学习率和更新次数；不对每种结构单独调参。    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=0.003, weight_decay=0.)    before = model.layers[0].weight.detach().clone()    with torch.no_grad():        initial = (model(x_train) - y_train).square().mean().item()    for _ in range(steps):        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)        loss = (model(x_train) - y_train).square().mean()        loss.backward()        assert torch.isfinite(loss)        assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in model.parameters())        optimizer.step()    with torch.no_grad():        final = (model(x_train) - y_train).square().mean().item()        displacement = (model.layers[0].weight - before).norm().item()    assert math.isfinite(final) and math.isfinite(displacement)    return initial, final, displacement print("depth scale model | input_VJP first_W_grad last_W_grad feature_RMS | MSE_before MSE_after first_W_update")for depth in (2, 8, 24):    # 不同深度也复用相同前缀随机初始化；每个成对实验只改变 skip 开关。    template = Stack(depth, alpha=1., skip=False)    for scale_name, alpha in (("one", 1.), ("sqrt_depth", 1 / math.sqrt(depth))):        plain, residual = copy.deepcopy(template), copy.deepcopy(template)        plain.alpha = residual.alpha = alpha        residual.skip = True        assert all(torch.equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(plain.parameters(), residual.parameters()))        for name, model in (("plain", plain), ("residual", residual)):            diagnostics = probe(model)            optimization = train(model)            values = " ".join(f"{v:.5g}" for v in (*diagnostics, *optimization))            print(depth, scale_name, name, "|", values) # 恒等项不构成梯度下界：这两个是独立的线性反例，不是上面的 tanh 网络。z = torch.tensor([1., -2.], dtype=dtype, requires_grad=True)cancel = z + (-z)torch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(cancel.sum(), z)[0], torch.zeros_like(z))h = zfor _ in range(12):    h = h + htorch.testing.assert_close(torch.autograd.grad(h.sum(), z)[0], torch.full_like(z, 2. ** 12))print("通过：配对初值、有限训练、抵消反例和 2^12 梯度放大；表内数值仅适用于这个合成实验。")
